findings.excerpt: lemma Homeomorph.coe_pointReflection {V P : Type*} [AddGroup V] [TopologicalSpace V] [AddTorsor V P]
findings.problem: The only simp lemma for `Homeomorph.pointReflection` is the forward coercion. `Equiv.pointReflection_symm` is `@[simp]` and `ContinuousAffineEquiv.pointReflection` has simp lemmas for symm and toAffineEquiv, but the Homeomorph version has no simp lemma for `(Homeomorph.pointReflection p).symm` or for `.toEquiv`. So simp cannot reduce these terms, and `(Homeomorph.pointReflection p).symm` is not normalised to `Homeomorph.pointReflection p`. The one downstream use in Geometry/Manifold/Instances/Icc.lean does `simp [Homeomorph.pointReflection]`, which unfolds the definition to `constVSub.trans vaddConst` instead of using a canonical simp rule.
findings.proposed_change: Add the missing simp lemmas next to `coe_pointReflection`, mirroring the `Equiv` and `ContinuousAffineEquiv` API. First, `@[simp] lemma Homeomorph.pointReflection_symm (p : P) : (Homeomorph.pointReflection p).symm = Homeomorph.pointReflection p`, proved by `Homeomorph.ext` with `Equiv.pointReflection_symm`. Second, `@[simp] lemma Homeomorph.toEquiv_pointReflection (p : P) : (Homeomorph.pointReflection p).toEquiv = Equiv.pointReflection p := rfl`. Optionally add a non-simp `Homeomorph.pointReflection_apply : pointReflection p q = (p -ᵥ q) +ᵥ p`, matching `Equiv.pointReflection_apply`, which is deliberately not simp.
findings.benefit: Users and simp calls get the same normal form for Homeomorph point reflections as for `Equiv.pointReflection`, which then triggers the existing `@[simp]` lemmas such as `Equiv.pointReflection_self`, `pointReflection_vsub_left` and `right_vsub_pointReflection`. Callers like the Icc chart code no longer need `simp [Homeomorph.pointReflection]`, which exposes the internal `trans` decomposition.
